title: Theft protection
summary: Sua conta → Proteção contra roubo (ADR 0044, ADR 0051, security.md rule 14, bipe-chat/bipe#600). The owner picks 1 to 3 guardians from verified contacts. A guardian sees the accounts they protect and can mark one as stolen, or clear the mark.

name.description: The display name the app knows, else the @ (POST /v1/handles/resolve), else the Matrix ID.

userId.description: The Matrix ID of an account that chose the user.

markedAt.description: Set while a mark is on (GuardedAccount.mark.stolen_at).

guardians.description: At most maxGuardians (registries/theft-protection.json), in the order the server returns.

guarding.description: Accounts that chose the user. Empty: bipe_theft_guarding_empty.

lastMark.description: bipe_theft_last_mark (guardian name, date) when GuardianState.last_mark is set.

of.description: A verified contact that is not a guardian yet.

picker.description: Set while the picker sheet is open. Empty: bipe_theft_picker_empty.

appear.effect: Reads GET /v1/me/guardians and sets guardians, guarding and lastMark. Runs again when the app comes to the foreground.

openPicker.effect: Lists verified contacts (UserIdentity.isVerified, the in-person check of rule 3) that are not guardians. Disabled with bipe_theft_guardians_full at maxGuardians.

addGuardian.effect: PUT /v1/me/guardians with the list plus userId. Closes the picker.

userId.description: A protected account without a mark.

askMark.effect: confirm mark: bipe_theft_mark_confirm_title and bipe_theft_mark_confirm_body with the name.

mark.effect: After the owner check of the device (biometric or device PIN): POST /v1/theft/{userId}/mark, then appear.

userId.description: A protected account with a mark.

clear.effect: After the owner check: POST /v1/theft/{userId}/clear, then appear.

notes: One guardian is enough to mark (ADR 0044 working default). The mark locks the account on the server and ends every session; the stolen phone cannot clear it.
Clearing by CPF with the 72-hour wait (ADR 0051) is not in this version (MZ decision on bipe-chat/bipe#538): a guardian clears, or support after a CPF check by hand.

Every account on the phone sends the phone ID once per start (PUT /v1/me/phone, a random value kept on the phone, never from hardware). A mark then covers the personal accounts on that phone and ends that phone's sessions of a company account (bipe-chat/bipe#268).
The owner sees who set the last mark (lastMark). The mark is account metadata: messages and E2EE do not change.
Never show a Matrix ID where a name or an @ is known.
